title: Query Workload Logs
description: Optimized workload log query action that leverages the shared log ingestion and deduplication pipeline ([[log-ingestion-pipeline]]).

cluster_name.description: GKE cluster name. Currently informational only -- `pull_and_format_logs.py` scopes by `resource.labels.pod_name` and exposes no cluster flag, so this value is NOT applied to the query. Left declared because callers pass it and it documents which cluster the run belongs to; do not read a result as cluster-scoped on the strength of it.

restart_attempt.description: JobSet restart attempt index (optional, default -1 to query all attempts across the window in a single pass). When >= 0, filters logs specifically for this restart attempt.

start.description: Window start (RFC3339). With --end, queries the whole window in a single pass.

limit.description: Maximum log entries to return. Saturation is silent: if original_count == limit the result is truncated and proves nothing negative -- re-run narrowed or with a higher limit.

last_occurrence.description: Optional timestamp baseline; defaults to current UTC time if omitted.

output_file.description: Output path for formatted and deduplicated logs.
